comments.author: Snipe
comments.body:
The amount of Lumber needed for the first three recipes is wrong.

The "Sculpting a lion" recipe only requires 5 Lumber, contrary to the 10 stated above.

The "Sculpting a tiger" recipe only requires 8 Lumber, contrary to the 10 stated above.

The "Sculpting a panther" recipe only requires 7 Lumber, contrary to the 10 stated above.

comments.author: Grimmturd
comments.body: Also, note that Cape Verde is Cabo Verde. Late 2013, the nation that had been known in the United Nations as Cape Verde made a rare request to change the official name of the country to Cabo Verde “in all official languages of the United Nations . . . and request that it should not be translated." Game was created before this request and uses both spellings to refer to the same place.
